discovery_outcomes.subject: target_user
discovery_outcomes.target_segment_or_system: the configured technical owner completing matched core tasks in OpenLinear and the approved reference condition

metric.name: median reference-relative task-time overhead
metric.definition: median across approved tasks of one hundred times OpenLinear median completion time divided by Linear median completion time minus one hundred

guardrails.name: matched-task error rate

approved reference evidence remains admissible after qualified clean-room review

discovery_outcomes.subject: protected_quality

clean-room masks exclude only branding and documented volatile regions

supersedes.reason: Docker-host qualification is no longer a release requirement.

readiness.rationale: The original feature graph remains historical and traceable. Current new implementation follows the CT-79 architecture amendment through CT-80, CT-81, and CT-82. O-002 remains pending under the accepted-contract implementation-only exception, while CT-3 blocks the separate public-release path.

automatic_resolutions.rationale: Discovery explicitly records an actionable CT-2 baseline task and allows reversible implementation to continue while preserving all O-002 measurement and claim gates.
